title: This M6 Mac mini-Thunderbolt hub combo ($150 off) will future-proof your AI setup
content:
Macworld

M6 Mac mini for $779 ($120 off)

View Deal

We love the Mac mini, but we don’t love how much more it is to get higher storage capacities, especially since you can’t upgrade it after the fact. So here’s a solution: Grab the 256GB Mac mini M6 for $779 ($120 off) and with the savings grab the Satechi USB-C hub & stand for $70. They’re each at an all-time-low and together, they’ll solve the pricey storage issue. How? Let us explain.

You already how great the Mac mini is — it’s tiny, insanely powerful, and just about everything you could want from a home computer that’s so small, you can throw in a bag and take with you wherever you want. The M6 chip handles photo edits, video calls, and an endless list of browser tabs without issue. You’ll also get three Thunderbolt ports on this tiny computer, and that’s where the Satechi dock comes in.

The Satechi hub plugs into one of the Thunderbolt ports and fits neatly under the Mac mini to provide two front-facing 10Gbps USB-A ports, one 480Mbps USB-A port,and an SD card reader. The best part about this hub, however, is hidden inside—it’s also an NVMe SSD enclosure, allowing you to add up to 4TB of storage. We know storage prices are insane these days, but if you don’t have an NVMe drive on hand, you can get a 2TB drive for around $350, more than half off what Apple charges (yes storage prices are insane right now).

So, this Black Friday, save $120 on the powerful M6 Mac mini and grab a 30 percent discount on the Satechi hub.
